selected_bottleneck: federated-control-path-case-folding-boundary（联邦控制路径大小写折叠边界）
selected_problem: Fresh canonical main rejected blocked control-plane segments only by exact case. The federated proposal normalizer rejected .git/config but accepted .GIT/config and src/.GiT/hooks/pre-commit. On a case-insensitive workspace these spellings can address the same Git metadata, so an otherwise executable autonomous proposal could cross a boundary the same module already intended to block.
decision_basis: This closes an existing fail-closed path boundary instead of choosing a new product architecture or repository-context policy.
The blocked segment set already declares Git metadata, dependency/build outputs and runtime-data as non-proposal targets; the defect was case-sensitive enforcement of that existing rule.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502, so this cycle uses DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY（DWAC 源码契约重放） and does not claim a hosted DWAC success receipt.

pre_fix_reality.impact: case-variant control-plane paths could survive proposal normalization and become executable candidates

change: normalizeRel now compares each path segment to BLOCKED_SEGMENTS after lowercase normalization. The same canonical boundary is therefore enforced independent of path-segment casing for both changes and needs_more_context.

truth_boundary: This closes case-variant aliases for the federation module's already-blocked control-path segments. It does not claim filesystem-wide case equivalence, Unicode normalization equivalence, complete credential-write policy, parser-grade module semantics, or arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
